01_Finance.description: General banking, investments, credit cards, non-property accounts
01_Finance.entity_rule: Financial institution or broker name (e.g. Chase, Vanguard, Fidelity, PNC)
01_Finance.entity_tooltip: Enter the name of the bank, credit card company, or investment broker. Zero spaces (use underscores).
01_Finance.category_tooltip: Select the account type or document category.

02_Home.description: Physical real estate properties, mortgages, utilities, repairs, maintenance
02_Home.entity_rule: Property address including street, city, and state code: {Street_Address}_{City}_{ST} (e.g. 45_Craighead_St_Pittsburgh_PA)
02_Home.entity_tooltip: MUST include street, city, and 2-letter state code. Never omit city/state. Example: 45_Craighead_St_Pittsburgh_PA
02_Home.category_tooltip: Repairs = fixing broken items; Maintenance = routine upkeep/pest control; Renovations = structural/aesthetic upgrades; Utilities = recurring services.

03_Vehicles.description: Cars, motorcycles, trucks, DMV, vehicle repairs, insurance
03_Vehicles.entity_tooltip: Format as YYYY_Make_Model with underscores. Never mix vehicles together.
03_Vehicles.category_tooltip: Repairs = fixing defects; Maintenance = oil changes/inspections; DMV = registration/title.

04_Pets.description: Pet veterinary care, medications, vaccinations, pet insurance
04_Pets.entity_tooltip: Enter the pet's name. Use underscores if multi-word.
04_Pets.category_tooltip: Select the veterinary or care category for this pet.

05_Legal.description: Attorneys, general contracts, estate planning (NOT property/vehicle specific)
05_Legal.entity_rule: Law firm, legal entity, or matter name (e.g. Estate_Planning, Jones_Law_Firm)
05_Legal.entity_tooltip: Name of legal entity or matter. If document relates to a specific house or vehicle, route under 02_Home or 03_Vehicles instead.

06_Employment.entity_rule: Employer or company name (e.g. Google, Acme_Corp, CMU)

07_Insurance.description: General personal insurance policies (health, life, disability — NOT vehicle/home specific)
07_Insurance.entity_rule: Insurance carrier or policy type (e.g. BlueCross_BlueShield, Northwestern_Mutual)
07_Insurance.entity_tooltip: Carrier name. Property and auto insurance belong under 02_Home or 03_Vehicles.

08_Travel.entity_tooltip: Destination or trip identifier with year.

09_Personal.description: Personal identity, medical records, correspondence, memberships
09_Personal.entity_rule: Subject or organization (e.g. Medical_Records, Vital_Records, Subscriptions)

10_Rental_Property.description: Rental income properties with tenant sub-entities
10_Rental_Property.entity_tooltip: Full property address with city and state code.

11_Taxes.description: Annual tax filings, IRS / state filings, year-end forms
11_Taxes.category_tooltip: Select tax jurisdiction or document stage.

99_Unsorted.description: Fallback for strictly unrecognizable or unreadable files
99_Unsorted.entity_tooltip: Use when document cannot be classified into any domain.
